about_the_game:
A Mythic Music Action Game Where Sound and Story Intertwine

Step into a wholly original music action game inspired by ancient mythology, where your actions guide both the music and the unfolding tale.

At its core, the game blends minimalist soundscapes with deeply immersive rhythm-based gameplay. As you execute actions together with subtly evolving beats, you’ll move forward in the story—synchronizing your play with a living, ritualistic world. The trance-like repetition of tones creates a meditative flow state, drawing you into a musical experience that feels both mystic and intense.

Features:

  • Immersive trance gameplay: Experience unique patterns and rhythms that shift and evolve like a ritual in motion.

  • Exiting action: Take on a large variety of foes and bosses and unleash your battle skills on them.

  • Original soundtrack: Each of your actions will pair with the minimalistic BGM to form a unique pattern.

  • Mythological narrative: A rich story told through music, visuals, and gameplay—where harmony must be restored through rhythmic trials.

  • Single-player focused: Designed for an introspective, immersive solo experience with handcrafted stages and narrative arcs.

Story Overview

In the primordial age before heaven and earth were divided, the Sun and Moon were born.

At the end of their cycle, they intertwined and gave birth to a child, who was tasked with maintaining order on the surface world. But each time that child perished, harmony vanished with it. So to restore balance, the Sun and Moon would summon champions and begin the great "Matsuri", a sacred ritual where rhythm becomes the path to rebirth.

Take your place as one of the chosen and step into this mythic clash. Through rhythm, awaken a new world.

name: Twin Soul

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD FX-8350 / Intel® Core™ i5-3330
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon™ R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound® compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 3100 / Intel® Core™ i7-3770
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 6 GB VRAM / Radeon™ RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound® compatible sound card

short_description: Dive into Twin Soul, a music action game set in a world inspired by ancient myths. You'll journey through different areas, facing off against powerful gods to clear stages. You will experience the story from two perspectives as you uncover the contrasting paths of our two heroes.
